question: Where can I get a list of battery storage (BESS) installations in operation in France, with location, power (MW), energy (MWh), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: The official answer is the Registre national des installations de production et de stockage d'électricité on ODRÉ (RTE with Enedis, EDF SEI and local DSOs). Filtering codeFiliere STOCK gives 938 in-service storage rows (including 10 flywheel and 7 'Autre') at 30/09/2026 (2,453 MW, ≈3,347 MWh) with commune, charge/discharge kW, storable kWh, connection and commissioning dates. It does not publish the battery operator (only the grid operator), gives no coordinates, has no MWh for the 7 ZNI rows and no Mayotte row. Operators come from CRE ZNI deliberations, owner releases and OSM (23 large plants, joinable by EIC code).
main_caveats: gestionnaire is the network operator (RTE, Enedis, EDF-SEI, ELD), not the battery operator; the exploitant is collected but not public.
dateMiseEnService is the grid operator's view: Cernay-lès-Reims shows 12/01/2026, the owner reports commercial operation since May 2026.
Hybrid batteries sit inside PV, wind, hydro or thermal rows (39 individual rows with typeStockage BATTE outside STOCK; small PV only as aggregates).
ZNI: only 7 EDF SEI rows without MWh or names; Mayotte absent (CRE deliberations fill part); EDF island batteries on Sein/Ouessant absent.
Row counts are not site or company counts: 706 rows are distributed 'NWJ' units of ≈1.25 MW; some sites have several rows.
Totals differ by source: register 31/12/2025 mainland 741 rows/1,531 MW/1,762 MWh vs CRE 758 projects/1,512 MW/1,720 MWh.
answer.confidence_reason: Register downloaded and profiled, fine print quoted from glossary and arrêté; operator gap is legal. ZNI checked only through register copies and one CRE case; Corsica EDF document blocked.

attributes.note: Register: commune and INSEE code for all 938 rows (IRIS for 40), no coordinates; OSM gives exact geometry for 23 large plants; CRE names the commune for Mayotte.
Register kW: puisMaxInstallee (max output), puisMaxCharge (charging), puisMaxInstalleeDisCharge and connection kW; charge empty in 89 rows, discharge in 104.
energieStockable (kWh) >0 in 912 of 938 rows; CRE gives usable MWh for contracted ZNI sites; owner pages (Corse row: 10 MWh) and OSM (12 plants) fill some gaps.
attributes.gap_note: No energy for the 7 EDF SEI rows (Corse, DOM), empty in 19 rows and 1-2 kWh placeholders in 14 rows of the register at 30/09/2026; not derivable from MW.

attributes.note: Register shows only the grid operator and an installation name (706 'NWJ…', 164 'Confidentiel'); operators from CRE ZNI deliberations, owner releases and OSM (17 plants).
attributes.gap_note: The register collects 'nom de l'exploitant' (item 1A) but the arrêté du 7 juillet 2016, art. 4, leaves it out of the public data; no public operator list found at RTE, Enedis, CRE or NW.

attributes.note: dateMiseEnService (grid-side 'mise en service industrielle') in 933 rows, dateRaccordement in the rest; commercial operation can be months later.

sources.name: Registre national des installations de production et de stockage d'électricité (au 30/09/2026)
sources.publisher: RTE (compiler, art. L142-9-1 Code de l'énergie) with data from Enedis, EDF SEI and local DSOs (ELD); published on Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ)
sources.format: CSV, JSON, XLSX exports and Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1 (JSON)
sources.summary: Official per-installation register (RTE/Enedis/EDF SEI/ELD) on ODRÉ; filter codeFiliere STOCK: 938 rows in service at 30/09/2026 (incl. 10 flywheel, 7 'Autre'), 2,453 MW puisMaxInstallee, ≈3,347 MWh.
sources.coverage_note: All networks of mainland France plus 7 EDF SEI rows (Corse 1, Guadeloupe 1, Martinique 1, Guyane 2, Réunion 2); Mayotte absent. Location = commune/INSEE, no coordinates. Operator not published.
caveats: gestionnaire is the grid operator, not the battery operator; 164 names are 'Confidentiel'.
dateMiseEnService is grid-side commissioning, not commercial operation.
EDF SEI rows carry no MWh; 14 rows have 1-2 kWh placeholders.
Batteries in hybrid plants sit in PV/wind rows (typeStockage BATTE).

sources.name: CRE deliberations on centralised storage in non-interconnected zones (compensation decisions, guichets, contract amendments)
sources.summary: CRE deliberations (PDF) on contracted ZNI storage give operator, commune, MW, usable MWh and real commissioning date; they fill the Mayotte gap of the register.
sources.coverage_note: Only storage contracted with ZNI system operators; tested on Mayotte (TotalEnergies Renewables ESS Mayotte, 4 MW/2 MWh, in service 24/01/2024).
caveats: Documents, not a dataset: one PDF per decision.
Guichet decisions list projects, not operating sites.

example.example_request: https://www.cre.fr/fileadmin/Documents/Deliberations/2025/250724_2025-203_CDS_Batterie_TE_Mayotte.pdf, pages 1-2, §1.2 'Objet du projet d’avenant au contrat d’achat'.
example.example_result: TotalEnergies Renewables ESS Mayotte; Koungou (Longoni); 4 MW; capacité utile 2 MWh; batteries lithium-ion; mise en service le 24 janvier 2024; contrat EDM 15 ans.

sources.name: Battery owners' and operators' press releases and site pages
sources.publisher: Battery owners/operators (TagEnergy with Banque des Territoires, Harmony Energy, NW Groupe, others)
sources.format: PDF press releases and HTML pages
sources.summary: Owner/operator releases identify who runs large sites and when commercial operation began; tested for Cernay-lès-Reims, Cheviré, and ZNI sites in Corse (Corsica Sole, 10 MWh) and Martinique (Akuo); NW publishes only totals.
sources.coverage_note: Ad hoc, large sites only; no list.

members_summary.scope_note: Universe of battery operators unknown; the ATEE/CRE observatory identified 45 organisations for HTA/HTB storage in mainland France (31 responded). Tested: 2 mainland RTE sites, NW, and 2 of the 7 EDF SEI ZNI rows (Corse, Martinique).
members_summary.pattern: Search '<commune> stockage batteries MW MWh mise en service' or the operator named in OSM; owner press releases and the Banque des Territoires 'réalisations' pages carry dates.

sources.name: Parc de production et de stockage - Sein Ouessant Molene
sources.publisher: EDF (Systèmes Énergétiques Insulaires) on the EDF open data portals (data-fair)
sources.summary: EDF open data list of Sein/Ouessant/Molène plants: two EDF batteries (200 kW and 1 MW, 2017) with coordinates, absent from the national register.
sources.coverage_note: Three Breton islands only; end-2018 snapshot; no MWh.
caveats: The same EDF portals also host copies of the national register per ZNI (Corse, DOM, SPM); those copies add nothing for storage.

if_unstructured.summary: The register lacks the operator, ZNI energy and Mayotte; CRE deliberations on ZNI storage and owner press releases give these site by site, and OSM links large sites to register EIC codes.

local_terms.term: Registre national des installations de production et de stockage d'électricité
local_terms.meaning: Official national register on ODRÉ, compiled by RTE; the per-installation list of storage.
Register filière for batteries, flywheels and hydrogen storage; filter value.
Storage type codes: battery / volant d'inertie (flywheel).
Storable energy field (kWh) in the register.
Commissioning date as seen by the network operator; not commercial operation.
Grid operator (RTE, Enedis, EDF SEI, ELD) shown in the register; not the battery operator.
Installation operator; collected in the register but not published.
Corsica, overseas departments and islands not connected to the mainland grid; storage contracts reviewed by CRE.

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
